intent: Append-only repository port of Telemetry Event Log. appendRecord is idempotent by sample identity (deviceId, metric, tDeviceEpochMs): emits true when newly stored, false when duplicate. appendRevision appends a new revision referencing the original; originals never modified. findByDeviceAndRange reads records by device and t_device range [from,to]. Domain types only; no update/delete.

methods.signature: Flux<TelemetrySample> findByDeviceAndRange(String deviceId, long fromEpochMs, long toEpochMs)
